description_en: Modify the site hosting transformation configuration
description_zh: 修改站点托管转换配置
name: UpdateManagedTransform

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add a header that contains visitor geolocation information. Valid values:

`on`: Add the header.

`off`: Do not add the header
parameters.help_zh:
添加访问者地理位置标头。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: add_client_geolocation_header

parameters.help_en: The version of the site. For sites with version management enabled, this parameter specifies the version to which the configuration applies. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add the `ali-real-client-ip` header, which contains the real client IP. Valid values:

`on`: Add the header.

`off`: Do not add the header
parameters.help_zh:
添加包含真实客户端IP的 "ali-real-client-ip" 标头。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: add_real_client_ip_header

parameters.help_en: The name of the header that contains the real client IP. The name must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits (0-9), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 真实客户端IP标头名称，以大小写字母开头，包含0-9的数字及字符(-)
parameters.name: real_client_ip_header_name
